_about: 注: knowledge figures, each defined once, keyed by id. The book writes [words]{注=id}; the reader (scripts/read-md.js) sets the figure in the text right under that paragraph. image is under this world folder; lines are 2–3 short lines; credit and source say where the picture is from.
_marks: The animation layer (scripts/marks.js): ratio = the image's height/width; points [{id, label, x, y}] and paths [{id, d: [[x, y]…], through: [point ids, in flow order]}], x/y in 0–1 of the image, drawn as an SVG over it.

zh: 督脉沿脊背正中上行，小周天的气从这里往上走，要过三道关。
尾闾在脊骨尽头，图上是长强，底下题着「尾閭穴，朝天嶺，氣海門，曹溪路」。
夹脊在两肩胛之间，图上没题这两个字，约当至阳；玉枕在后脑，图上就题着「玉枕」。
en: The Du channel runs up the middle of the back; the small circuit's qi climbs it through three passes.
Weilü is the foot of the spine — the plate's Changqiang, captioned below: Weilü cavity, Chaotian ridge, Qihai gate, Caoxi road.
Jiaji lies between the shoulder blades — unnamed on the plate, near Zhiyang; Yuzhen, the back of the head, the plate names outright.

credit.en: Xingming guizhi, the Back-view plate (Fanzhao tu), Ming dynasty. Public domain.
